name: ICT 2022 Mentorship model — raid, shift, FVG (Jev-refined)
description: Liquidity is raided; displacement breaks short-term structure the other way and leaves a fair value gap. Enter at the gap's edge in the discount (long) / premium (short) half of the swing just created, on the right side of the NY midnight opening price, inside the New York killzone; unfilled orders are pulled at 11:30 NY. Stop 5 pips beyond the raid; target the opposing liquidity. v3 rules come from the top Jev-ranked passages of episodes 1-21 (710 tagged windows).

nodes.label: Costs ≤ 25% of risk
nodes.description: Execution realism, not ICT doctrine: on 5-minute charts stops can be a few pips, where Deriv spread + commission would consume most of 1R. Rejects setups whose round-trip cost exceeds 25% of the risk.

nodes.label: Displacement quality

question.instructions: How strong is the move described in `displacement`, in the sense of an energetic, one-directional move away from the raided level that breaks structure?
criteria: Weak: small, overlapping, hesitant candles; barely breaks structure.
Moderate: some larger candles, but choppy or with long opposing wicks.
Strong: several large-bodied candles closing near their extremes, clearly breaking structure.
Explosive: a fast, one-sided move that decisively breaks structure and leaves a clear gap.

nodes.description: Jev grades the displacement from facts code computed (body/ATR, closes near extreme, candle count). Fallback: normalised body/ATR ≥ 0.3.

citations.title: 2022 ICT Mentorship Episode 11
citations.note: the displacement comes… it gives you a confirmation

nodes.label: Daily draw on liquidity agrees

question.instructions: Given `daily_context`, where is price more likely to be drawn next today? Liquidity that has already traded today is no longer a draw.

criteria.buy_side_above: Toward buy-side liquidity above, such as the previous day high.
criteria.sell_side_below: Toward sell-side liquidity below, such as the previous day low.
criteria.unclear: The facts do not favour either side.

nodes.description: Trade only toward the daily draw on liquidity. Jev judges it from the daily facts, including whether the previous day high/low has already traded today. Fallback rule (v2): the opposing previous-day extreme must still be resting, untaken today.

nodes.label: Holistic model check (flag)

question.instructions: The facts in state describe ICT's 2022 model: liquidity was raided, then displacement broke the short-term structure the other way and left a fair value gap, during a New York or London session, with the trade aimed at opposing liquidity.

criteria.true: All parts of the model are present and consistent.
criteria.false: A part is missing or contradicts the model.

nodes.description: A sanity judgment over the whole setup; it only flags, so it can be measured before it is trusted.
